Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As we scope HelioMed's pilot (PHI-adjacent telemetry and clinician notes enrichment), Legal & Security need three items before we can greenlight a test environment:

1) A firm confirmation that Redwood can commit to EU-only processing for HelioMed production data (data at rest & in-transit processing to remain in EU regions). We also need detail on routing controls and enforcement (VPC/private connectors, control plane routing, and any fallbacks).

2) Completed SIG questionnaire and a copy of a redacted SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 bridge letter) — we will accept redacted PDFs and marked-up SIG spreadsheets.

3) A DPA template indicating SCCs (or confirmation that Redwood will sign EU SCCs) and the draft for our procurement review. Are you able to provide a DocuSign-ready DPA?

I've attached a short packet that includes our security questionnaire and DPA cover page. 

Attachments: HelioMed_SIG_Request.xlsx (xlsx), HelioMed_DPA_Request.pdf (pdf)

Can you confirm next steps and expected turnaround? We are aiming to start ingesting test traffic in late June.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena —

Thanks for the clear summary and the packet. We're happy to support HelioMed's EU-only production constraint; a few clarifying items so we scope correctly:

- Do you require all processing (including metadata, logs, and backups) to remain in EU regions, or just primary model inference for customer data?
- Is HelioMed planning to use Redwood Hosted (our EU regions) or Dedicated/Private (VPC) for the pilot? The enforcement controls differ slightly.
- For SCCs: we can sign the standard EU SCCs in our DPA. Our legal can prepare a DocuSign-enabled DPA for review once scope is confirmed.

We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a populated SIG spreadsheet. I'll loop in Aditya (sales lead) and Irene (security/compliance) to coordinate the evidence packet and DPA draft.

Proposed next steps:
- I will confirm the exact data categories covered by HelioMed (metadata, telemetry, PII/PHI) so we can determine hosting requirements.
- Security will prepare a redacted SOC2 and a completed SIG XLSX within 3 business days (redactions for customer IDs and system-level secrets).
- Legal will produce a DocuSign-ready DPA with SCCs attached — expect draft in 4 business days after scope confirmation.

If that timeline works, can you confirm scope (full data + logs/backups vs inference-only)?

Best,
